Help
Step by step help for Wi-Fi, internet and mobile data.
How to connect
Relay is not offered by the server right now.
Step %1$s of %2$s, %3$s
Open ReyDesk on both devices
Open ReyDesk and stay on the Connect page. Both devices must use the same Wi-Fi.
Open ReyDesk on the Connection tab. Check that the phone uses the same Wi-Fi as the PC.
Choose a mode
Nothing to do here yet. The Connect page shows a QR code for the phone.
Choose Desktop to see and control the PC screen, or Control to use the PC without sharing its screen.
Choose how to pair
Keep the Connect page open. It shows the QR code, and phones on this Wi-Fi can find the PC.
Pick QR code to scan the PC screen, or Nearby to pick the PC from a list.
Scan the QR code
Keep the QR code on screen. If it expired, click Generate new code.
Tap Scan QR code in the ring and point the camera at the PC screen. Then tap Connect under the device name.
Pick the PC from Nearby
Keep the Connect page open. The PC answers nearby phones only while this page is open.
Under Nearby computers, tap Connect next to your PC. If it is missing, tap the refresh button.
Compare the code
The PC shows Compare this code with the phone. Check that the phone shows the same 6 digits.
If both screens show the same 6 digits, tap Same code. If not, tap Different code.
Approve on the PC
In Allow this phone to connect?, click Approve. To reach this PC from outside later, also tick Also allow this phone to connect over the internet.
Wait for the PC to approve. The session starts by itself when it is done.
Turn on internet on both devices
On the Connect page, turn on Internet connection and wait until it shows Online.
Open Settings, go to Internet connect and turn on Allow internet connections. Wait until it shows Online.
Note the ReyDesk ID
Your ReyDesk ID is on the Connect page in three groups of four characters. Click Copy to share it.
On the phone, this ID goes into the Desk ID field, unless you scan the QR code.
Choose how to pair
You can show a 6 digit code, or let the phone scan the QR code on this page.
Pick Code to type the ID and a code, or QR code if you can point the camera at the PC screen.
Get a code on the PC
Click Add a phone from the internet. A 6 digit code appears with a timer; when it runs out, click Generate new code.
Open the Over the internet card on the Connection tab.
Enter the ID and code
Keep the code panel open until the phone connects.
Type the ReyDesk ID in Desk ID and the 6 digits in Pairing code, then tap Connect.
Compare the code
The PC shows Compare this code with the phone. This check code is not the code you typed.
If both screens show the same 6 digits, tap Same code. If they differ, tap Different code and start again.
Scan the QR code
Keep the QR code on the Connect page in view. With Internet connection on, it also works when the phone is not on your Wi-Fi.
Tap Scan QR code, point the camera at the PC screen, then tap Connect. You do not compare a code.
Approve on the PC
When the PC asks Allow this phone to connect?, click Approve. A phone\'s first pairing over the internet always needs approval on this PC.
Wait for the PC. On mobile data, if the session does not start within about 10 seconds, open the Mobile data guide.
How connecting over the internet works

Your phone and this PC find each other through the ReyDesk server using the Desk ID. The server only introduces them. Then the two devices try to open a direct, encrypted path between themselves. On home Wi-Fi this almost always works. Mobile carriers often put many users behind one shared address, which blocks direct paths.
On the same Wi-Fi as the PC you need neither Internet connection nor relay. Use them only when the phone is on mobile data or another network. Turn on Internet connection on the PC first, then pair.
When to turn relay on

Leave relay off if the connection works: it is off by default, a direct path is faster and keeps your stream off the server. Turn Allow relay on when pairing succeeds but the session stays on connecting or fails, usually on mobile data or strict networks. Open Settings, Internet and switch it on.

Relay is a choice you make on each device: turn Allow relay on in Settings on the phone too. If the direct path fails while relay is off, the app shows a hint after about 15 seconds. Turn relay off again when you are back on Wi-Fi.
What relay does and costs

With relay, the stream is forwarded by the ReyDesk relay server because the two devices cannot reach each other. It stays encrypted end to end, so the server cannot see your screen. It can be slower, uses the server bandwidth, and works only while the server offers it. Direct paths are always tried first.
While the stream goes through the server, the path badge shows Relay. If the badge never appears and the session keeps connecting, check that relay is on for both the phone and the PC.
Connect as usual
Pair or reconnect as in the Internet guide, with Internet connection on.
Use Scan QR code or the Over the internet card, as in the Internet guide.
Use the PC from your phone
The Connect page shows the connected phone and how it is connected. Click Disconnect all to end every session.
In Desktop mode you see the PC screen and control it by touch. Use the toolbar to end the session.
Reconnect later
When A trusted phone wants to connect appears, click Approve. Over the internet, the phone must have been allowed for the internet when you approved it.
Open the Devices tab and tap Reconnect on your PC. Over the internet, Allow internet connections must be on on both devices.
Reconnect without a prompt
Optional: on Trusted devices, turn on Allow automatic reconnect on the phone\'s card and confirm. Keep it off for shared phones.
On the same Wi-Fi, tap Reconnect next to the PC under Nearby computers. The PC then lets the phone in without asking.
Trusted devices
Trusted devices lists every phone you approved. You can rename one, change automatic reconnect, or forget it so it has to pair again.
The Devices tab lists the PCs this phone trusts. If you forget a PC there, pair again with the QR code or a code.
